title: Excellent, Fun Informative Tour
text: Our guide Sergio is a delightful person with a wealth of knowledge of Barcelona, Gaudi’s houses and Santa Familia. His ability to navigate the city in his vehicle and provide door to door service in each location is above and beyond. Best of all he was so flexible based on our requests. Highly, highly recommended

title: What a wonderful day...
text: What a wonderful day spent discovering Barcelona with our guide, Javier! He was knowledgeable, personable & professional. His itinerary covered the historical highlights of this beautiful city and the architectural and design influences of Antoni Gaudí. I would highly recommend spending a day on this tour with Javier!
author: Donna_S

title: Phenomenal Day!
text:
We had an outstanding, truly informative day, highlighting the Gothic Quarter, the key structures of Barcelona and all of the phenomenal Gaudi buildings and projects in the city! Sergio, our tour guide was extremely knowledgeable, highly engaging and very kind. He shared so many stories facts and details  associated with Mr. Gaudi. 
It was particularly wonderful to have the fast pass, VIP treatment at the Familia Segrada. Sergio pointed out every single interesting detail behind promoting Gaudi’s creation. We only had two full days to visit Barcelona. Committing this day using this outstanding
